_comment: Transliterations for non-Latin Wikimedia Commons file titles and author names, consumed by server/photo-selection.mjs. Attribution must name the original author, but this is an English-language storefront, so the display label is transliterated here. Keys are matched as substrings of the original title or author string; the untranslated originals remain in public/img/credits.json for auditability.
